books.title: Conversations with Friends
books.author: Sally Rooney
books.synopsis: Frances, a young Dublin poet and student, and her ex-girlfriend Bobbi perform spoken word together and become entangled with an older writer, Melissa, and her actor husband Nick. Frances begins an affair with Nick while examining her own detachment and the limits of intimacy.

mentions.author: George Eliot
